title: Server and HTTP API integration
summary: Test real Hono routes, persistence, errors, WebSocket events, and archive endpoints.
description: Start the real plan-server against an isolated temporary planner and exercise its HTTP contract with fetch, not mocked route handlers. Cover project/feature/phase/task/requirement CRUD, validation failures and status codes, references, reorder, checklist operations, repair/integrity, export, active task queries, handoff read/write/clear/archive, and `/handoffs/archive`. Verify that successful mutations persist to `.planner`, failed mutations do not partially write, composite references are accepted and returned consistently, and WebSocket/live-sync events are emitted for relevant changes. Include server startup/static Web UI serving and dynamic-port cleanup. Preserve the server's harness-agnostic API contract and avoid binding tests to implementation-private PlanStore details.

tasks.title: Create real HTTP server integration harness
tasks.description:
Build a server integration fixture that creates a temporary PlanStore/project, starts the real Hono server on a dynamic port with static assets disabled or controlled, exposes fetch helpers, and reliably closes HTTP/WebSocket resources. Verify route errors are surfaced as test failures with request/response diagnostics and that every test starts from an isolated filesystem state.

---

Independent review approved. Added reusable real-server fixture helpers in `test/helpers/server-fixture.mjs` and 5 HTTP integration tests in `packages/plan-server/test/server-fixture.test.mjs`: dynamic-port API-only server, real filesystem persistence, diagnostics for failed routes/validation, fixture isolation, and handle/temp-root cleanup. Personally verified isolated 5/5 and `pnpm test` with build 264/264. No commit/push.

tasks.title: Test server handoff and archive endpoints
tasks.description:

Cover pending handoff reads, write replacement archival, terminal-phase rejection, clear archival, stale completed-phase cleanup, archive metadata/content/file mapping, newest-first ordering, and empty states. Verify responses never expose archived content through the active endpoint and retain composite phase references.

---

tasks.notes:
P054/F015 — T234 test server handoff e archive endpoints. Progresso round 1 (in attesa review):

Deliverable: packages/plan-server/test/server-handoff.test.mjs (NUOVO, 9 test) via harness T232 (server reale, fixture isolate, zero mock). Nessuna modifica a codice prod.

Copertura (contratto HTTP reale):
- Empty states: /handoffs [], /handoffs/archive [], phase senza handoff {content:"",updatedAt:""}.
- Write→read round trip: PUT {content} → {content,updatedAt ISO}; GET /phases/:id/handoff identico; /handoffs attivo con compositeRef P00x(F00x), firstLine, content, featureId, newest-first.
- Write replacement archival: PUT v1 poi v2 → archive 1 entry reason "superseded", content v1, file handoff-archive/<id>-<ts>.md fisicamente su disco (.planner/.local/handoff-archive/); l'endpoint attivo espone SOLO v2 (archived mai esposto su active).
- Clear: DELETE → {cleared:true}, content "", archive reason "manual"; empty PUT (spazi) = clear equivalente (anche con JSON malformato → {cleared:true} e contenuto archiviato).
- Terminal-phase rejection: fase derivata "done" (tutti i task done, previa feature governance) → PUT handoff → 404 {error:"not found", message:/Cannot write a handoff on done phase/}; stale pending handoff auto-archiviato come "phase-done" da GET /handoffs (mai in active).
- Ordering newest-first: active e archive ordinati per timestamp desc (test con 2 phase + sleep).
- Invalid paths: GET/PUT/DELETE su phase ignota → 404 "phase not found".
- Persistenza restart: 2° server stesso planRoot → active v2 + archive superseded v1 intatti.

OSSERVAZIONI DI DESIGN (documentate nel test, NON bug da fixare — nessuna modifica prod):
1. PUT /phases/:id accetta status:"done"/"canceled" (200, echo nel body) ma NON lo persiste: lo status fase è DERIVATO dai task (AGENTS.md punto 2). Un PUT status su fase taskless lascia lo stato derivato (draft/planned) invariato — testato e pinnato in "taskless phase PUT status canceled is echoed but not persisted".
2. derivePhaseStatus NON emette MAI "canceled" (terminali raggiungibili: done, rejected): il branch "canceled" della guardia setPhaseHandoff è irraggiungibile via contratto HTTP reale; la terminal-phase rejection è testata sull'unico stato terminale raggiungibile (derived done).

Verifiche: server dir 33/33 (24 + 9 nuovi) · pnpm check exit 0 · pnpm test 288/288 exit 0 (coverage 55.47/75.42/73.05 ≥ 45/74/61). Nessun commit/push, nessun task_complete — in attesa review.

tasks.description:

tasks.notes:
P054/F015 — T235 test server live events e static UI serving. Progresso round 1 (in attesa review):

Deliverable: packages/plan-server/test/server-events.test.mjs (NUOVO, 6 test) via harness T232 (server reale, WsHub reale, filesystem reale, zero mock). Nessuna modifica a codice prod.

Copertura:
1. Startup/shutdown: porta dinamica OS-assigned, probe API reale; close() risolve, fetch post-close → connection refused, close idempotente.
2. Static SPA (staticDir custom con index.html+asset): GET / → index.html text/html; asset esatti con content-type corretti (js/css); SPA fallback su GET unmatched → index.html 200; POST unmatched → 404 {error:"not found"} (mai fallback SPA); separazione API/static: /api/features e /api/project → JSON (mai index.html).
3. API-only mode (staticDir ""): GET / → 404, API funziona.
4. Live events via WebSocket reale (/ws, ws package): connected iniziale; ping→pong; mappa broadcast completa:
   - features-updated {action:created|updated|deleted, id, featureId}
   - requirements-updated (documento {requirements:[...]} con il req creato)
   - phases-updated {action:created|updated|deleted|task-created|task-updated|task-deleted, id, phaseId, featureId, taskId}
   - project-updated (body)
   - handoffUpdated/handoffCleared {phaseId}
   - plan-rendered
   - file-changed dal watcher filesystem reale (scrittura probe in .planner → filename nel payload)
5. Event-await helper: connessione WS + inbox + attesa polling per predicato (nessun sleep fisso → zero flakiness da timing).
6. Teardown: la close del server chiude anche la connessione WS del client (close event osservato lato client).

Note di sviluppo: fix call-site ws.close() (firma code/data); shape requirements-updated = documento non array; PUT fase con body stale (catturato prima della create task) sovrascriveva e perdeva il task → rifetch prima del PUT (documentato nel test).
